nutrition.publication: all values need finished-product evidence on the same basis; unknown blocks

weights.rule: No generic finished multiplier or automatic raw nutrition declaration

foodEntityVersion.version: positive integer; append-only sequential per kind/id
foodEntityVersion.taxonomyEvidenceRef: null means unresolved assessment; nonempty source reference required for review eligibility

recipeVersion.version: append-only positive integer per stable recipe/dish
recipeVersion.references: kind/id/version must resolve uniquely to immutable food entities

cost.capturedAt: exact UTC ISO timestamp with milliseconds

recipeVersion.immutability: clone and deep-freeze in reference; production requires DB immutability and transaction/authorization enforcement

taxonomy.rule: No synonym collapse; IDs unique; referenced IDs exist; cross_contact links substances; no fixed UI chip count. Recipe must retain identical inherited source taxonomy rows; unresolved assessments block.

importDraft.rule: Source publication/validation flags never become authority; SHA256 canonical candidate binds independent server review

reviewContext.rule: Synthetic server context only. Production derives these from verified live staff/session/authorization records; client-provided booleans forbidden.

requirements.fixtures: validMeasurement states and negative unit/evidence/NaN/range/zero tests
validWeights keeps purchased/raw/finished and evidence distinct
appendVersion and appendFoodEntityVersion reject duplicate versions; copies are immutable; cost evidence frozen
importDraft always draft; reviewForPublication checks server authorization, exact digest, references and evidence
validTaxonomy separates types and checks inherited hazard reconciliation
macroBandMembership uses stored values without normalization; wholeDayFeasible always null

observedMapping.gap: No trans-fat column or explicit measurement state/unit/basis/evidence columns in capture; JSON content semantics not established. Existing numeric zero is not proof of measured zero.
No full extended nutrition or immutable ingredient/component/recipe/cost version relationships shown.
No macro-band version columns shown in captured columns; propose stored versioned bands, never code-label business keys.

unresolvedEvidence: Public capture contains no dedicated ingredient/recipe version table; actual current schema must be refreshed before migration design.
Server recalculation, quantity/component expansion, food evidence validation and complete-day feasibility are not implemented by this reference.
G-FOOD pilot recipes, validated nutrition, allergen/cross-contact evidence, shelf life and packaging remain required.
G-MACROS display midpoint/rounding convention remains unresolved; ratified bands unchanged.
Actual source import parser, formula handling, large-sheet boundaries, persistence, RLS/privileges and transactional publication await implementation.
